rows: Projections pause and stare; nearby rings turn towards you
Creatures and places turn hostile; rumours about you spread
The Dreamer shapes events around you (freshly written with apeiron, from hand-made pools without)
The dream bends hard around you; deep things come looking

items: Raised by lucidity and blatant magic, like glimmer in Caves of Qud. A leaky integrator: flares add to it, and it always leaks away over a sleep cycle. Beliefs draw it only when their rules visibly bend the dream; one whose rule is always overt draws it steadily, so any baseline is where that draw balances the leak. Wonder clears flares, once per marvel per cycle.
